english: A station is where food or drinks are prepared: the kitchen, the bar, a tandoor. Kitchen tickets (KOTs) print at the station that makes the item. Bills print separately, at the till.

O tipo é Interno (o que o hóspede deve; negativo se estiver em crédito, 0 se liquidado), Livro razão da cidade (uma fatura da empresa não paga; negativo para dinheiro pago antecipadamente) ou Depósito (um adiantamento pago por uma reserva futura). portuguese: Estadias além da data de saída. A auditoria não lança diária para estadias após a data de saída.

key: Step by step: choose the modules you want, then rooms, rates, and, if you run a restaurant, outlets, stations and tills. Each step asks only what it needs.
english: Step by step: choose the modules you want, then rooms, rates, and, if you run a restaurant, outlets, stations and tills. Each step asks only what it needs.
arabic: خطوة بخطوة: اختر الوحدات التي تريدها، ثم الغرف والأسعار، وإذا كان لديك مطعم، المنافذ والمحطات والصناديق. كل خطوة تطلب ما تحتاجه فقط.
spanish: Paso a paso: elija los módulos que necesita y luego configure las habitaciones y las tarifas. Si tiene un restaurante, agregue también los puntos de venta, las estaciones y las cajas. Cada paso solicita solo la información necesaria.
portuguese: Passo a passo: escolha os módulos desejados, depois quartos, tarifas e, se você tem restaurante, pontos de venda, estações e caixas registradoras. Cada etapa pergunta apenas o que precisa.

key: Step status must be done, skipped or pending.
english: Step status must be done, skipped or pending.
arabic: يجب أن تكون حالة الخطوة: مكتملة أو متخطاة أو معلقة.
spanish: El estado del paso debe ser completado, omitido o pendiente.
portuguese: O status da etapa deve ser concluído, ignorado ou pendente.

key: Still at the laundry ({v0}). It can be billed once it is back: when the bag is at the desk, mark it ready, then post it to the room.
english: Still at the laundry ({v0}). It can be billed once it is back: when the bag is at the desk, mark it ready, then post it to the room.
arabic: ما زالت في المغسلة ({v0}). يمكن فوترتها عند عودتها: عندما تصل الحقيبة إلى الاستقبال، اجعلها جاهزة ثم رحّلها إلى الغرفة.
spanish: Aún en lavandería ({v0}). Se puede facturar cuando regrese: al recibir la bolsa en recepción, márquela como lista y cárguela a la habitación.
portuguese: Ainda na lavanderia ({v0}). Pode ser cobrado assim que voltar: quando a bolsa estiver na mesa, marque-a como pronta e envie-a para o quarto.

key: Still being served overnight (a late bar): leave it and override with a reason.
english: Still being served overnight (a late bar): leave it and override with a reason.
arabic: ما زالت الخدمة مستمرة ليلًا (بار متأخر): اتركها وتجاوز مع ذكر السبب.
spanish: Si el servicio continúa durante la madrugada, conserve la cuenta y autorice la excepción con un motivo.
portuguese: Ainda sendo servido durante a noite (um bar tardio): deixe e anule com um motivo.

key: Still Due In. The next night audit marks them no-show if they have not checked in.
english: Still Due In. The next night audit marks them no-show if they have not checked in.
arabic: لا يزالون في قائمة الوصول. يسجّلهم تدقيق الليل التالي كعدم حضور إن لم يسجّلوا الدخول.
spanish: La llegada sigue pendiente de registrar. La próxima auditoría nocturna marcará al huésped como no presentado si aún no ha registrado su entrada.
portuguese: Ainda está previsto. Na noite seguinte, a auditoria os marcará como não comparecimento caso não tenham feito o check-in.

arabic: ما زالت غير مضافة إلى الفاتورة
spanish: Aún no está en la cuenta

key: still open - the slots worth selling first.
english: still open - the slots worth selling first.
arabic: ما زالت متاحة: الفترات الأولى بالبيع.
spanish: aún disponibles: horarios que conviene vender primero.
portuguese: ainda em aberto - os slots que valem a pena vender primeiro.

key: Stock destroyed outside a sale - spoiled, broken, dropped. Food that was cooked and then voided is already accounted for; it shows in the wastage report on its own.
english: Stock destroyed outside a sale - spoiled, broken, dropped. Food that was cooked and then voided is already accounted for; it shows in the wastage report on its own.
arabic: مخزون أُتلف خارج عملية بيع: فاسد أو مكسور أو سقط. الطعام الذي طُهي ثم أُلغي محسوب مسبقًا، ويظهر في تقرير الهدر وحده.
spanish: Existencias descartadas fuera de una venta por deterioro, rotura o caída. Los alimentos preparados y luego anulados ya se incluyen automáticamente en el informe de mermas.
portuguese: Estoque destruído fora de uma venda - estragado, quebrado, caído. Os alimentos que foram cozinhados e depois anulados já são contabilizados; ele aparece sozinho no relatório de desperdício.

key: Store the secret somewhere safe now - it can't be shown again. Rotate any time from here.
english: Store the secret somewhere safe now - it can't be shown again. Rotate any time from here.
arabic: احفظ السر في مكان آمن الآن، فلن يظهر مرة أخرى. يمكنك تجديده في أي وقت من هنا.
spanish: Guarde el secreto ahora en un lugar seguro; no se podrá mostrar otra vez. Puede renovarlo aquí cuando lo necesite.
portuguese: Guarde o segredo em algum lugar seguro agora - ele não poderá ser mostrado novamente. Gire a qualquer momento a partir daqui.

key: Stored encrypted. Channex: your user API key; STAAH/AioSell: from partner onboarding
english: Stored encrypted. Channex: your user API key; STAAH/AioSell: from partner onboarding
arabic: محفوظ مشفّرًا. Channex: مفتاح API الخاص بالمستخدم؛ STAAH/AioSell: من إعداد الشريك
spanish: Se almacena cifrado. Channex: su clave de API de usuario; STAAH/AioSell: credenciales proporcionadas al activar la integración
portuguese: Armazenado criptografado. Channex: sua chave API do usuário; STAAH/AioSell: desde a integração de parceiros

key: Subtotals by cashier and transaction code
english: Subtotals by cashier and transaction code
arabic: المجاميع الفرعية حسب الصراف ورمز المعاملة
spanish: Subtotales por cajero y código de transacción
portuguese: Subtotais por caixa e código de transação

key: Switch between the front and back camera
english: Switch between the front and back camera
spanish: Cambiar entre la cámara frontal y trasera
portuguese: Alternar entre a câmera frontal e traseira

key: Switch it on, save, and come back here.
english: Switch it on, save, and come back here.
arabic: فعّله واحفظ ثم عد إلى هنا.
spanish: Actívelo, guarde los cambios y vuelva aquí.

key: Switch off single tools for AI clients at this property. Staff can still do the same thing in Kamra.
english: Switch off single tools for AI clients at this property. Staff can still do the same thing in Kamra.
arabic: أوقف أدوات محددة لعملاء الذكاء الاصطناعي في هذا العقار. يظل بإمكان الموظفين تنفيذ الإجراء نفسه في Kamra.
spanish: Desactive herramientas concretas para los clientes de IA en este alojamiento. El personal puede seguir haciendo lo mismo en Kamra.
portuguese: Desative ferramentas únicas para clientes de IA nesta propriedade. A equipe ainda pode fazer a mesma coisa em Kamra.

key: Switch off the parts of Kamra this property doesn't run.
english: Switch off the parts of Kamra this property doesn't run.
arabic: أوقف أجزاء Kamra التي لا يستخدمها هذا العقار.
spanish: Desactive las funciones de Kamra que este alojamiento no utiliza.
portuguese: Desligue as partes de Kamra que esta propriedade não executa.

key: Switch off what this property doesn't run. Its apps leave the launcher, search and the AI agent's tools for everyone. Data is kept and comes back when you switch it on.
english: Switch off what this property doesn't run. Its apps leave the launcher, search and the AI agent's tools for everyone. Data is kept and comes back when you switch it on.
arabic: أوقف ما لا يستخدمه هذا العقار. تختفي تطبيقاته من المشغّل والبحث وأدوات وكيل الذكاء الاصطناعي للجميع. تُحفظ البيانات وتعود عند تفعيله.
spanish: Desactive los módulos que este alojamiento no utiliza. Dejarán de aparecer en el lanzador de aplicaciones, en las búsquedas y entre las herramientas disponibles para el agente de IA. Los datos se conservan y vuelven a aparecer cuando los active.
portuguese: Desligue o que esta propriedade não executa. Seus apps deixam o launcher, a busca e as ferramentas do agente de IA para todos. Os dados são mantidos e voltam quando você o liga.

key: Switch on what you need. You can change this any time in Settings.
english: Switch on what you need. You can change this any time in Settings.
arabic: فعّل ما تحتاجه. يمكنك تغيير ذلك في أي وقت من الإعدادات.
spanish: Active los módulos que necesite. Puede cambiarlos en cualquier momento en Configuración.
portuguese: Ligue o que você precisa. Você pode alterar isso a qualquer momento em Configurações.

key: Table ordering and in-room dining codes for {property}. Drawn on this device - no outside QR service.
english: Table ordering and in-room dining codes for {property}. Drawn on this device - no outside QR service.
arabic: رموز الطلب من الطاولات وطلب الطعام داخل الغرف لـ {property}. تُنشأ على هذا الجهاز - دون أي خدمة QR خارجية.
spanish: Códigos para pedidos desde mesas y habitaciones de {property}. Se generan en este dispositivo sin usar un servicio externo de códigos QR.
portuguese: Códigos de pedido de mesa e jantar no quarto para {property}. Desenhado neste dispositivo - nenhum serviço QR externo.

key: Take the deposit (or waive it with a reason) to continue.
english: Take the deposit (or waive it with a reason) to continue.
arabic: استلم التأمين (أو أعفِ منه مع ذكر السبب) للمتابعة.
spanish: Cobre el depósito de garantía o indique un motivo para exonerarlo y continuar.
portuguese: Aceite o depósito (ou renuncie com um motivo) para continuar.

key: Take the security deposit (or waive it with a reason) and any advance the booking still owes.
english: Take the security deposit (or waive it with a reason) and any advance the booking still owes.
arabic: خذ مبلغ التأمين (أو اعف منه مع ذكر السبب) وأي دفعة مقدمة لا يزال الحجز مدينا بها.
spanish: Cobre el depósito de garantía, o indique un motivo para exonerarlo, y el anticipo pendiente de la reserva.
portuguese: Pegue o depósito caução (ou renuncie com um motivo) e qualquer adiantamento que a reserva ainda deva.

key: Take the security deposit or waive it with a reason to continue.
english: Take the security deposit or waive it with a reason to continue.
arabic: خذ مبلغ التأمين أو اعف منه مع ذكر السبب للمتابعة.
spanish: Cobre el depósito de garantía o indique un motivo para exonerarlo y continuar.
portuguese: Aceite o depósito caução ou renuncie a ele com um motivo para continuar.

key: Taking or giving back money needs an open till, and your role can't open one. Ask {v0} to settle the bill.
english: Taking or giving back money needs an open till, and your role can't open one. Ask {v0} to settle the bill.
arabic: تحصيل الأموال أو ردها يتطلب صندوقًا مفتوحًا، ودورك لا يسمح بفتحه. اطلب من {v0} تسوية الفاتورة.
spanish: Para cobrar o devolver dinero se necesita una caja abierta y su rol no permite abrirla. Solicite a {v0} que liquide la cuenta.
portuguese: Receber ou devolver dinheiro precisa de uma caixa registradora aberta, e sua função não pode abrir uma. Peça ao {v0} para pagar a conta.

key: Tap a panel to show or hide it. Use the arrows to change the order.
english: Tap a panel to show or hide it. Use the arrows to change the order.
arabic: اضغط على اللوحة لإظهارها أو إخفائها. استخدم الأسهم لتغيير الترتيب.
spanish: Toque un panel para mostrarlo u ocultarlo. Utilice las flechas para cambiar el orden.
portuguese: Toque em um painel para mostrá-lo ou ocultá-lo. Use as setas para alterar a ordem.

key: Tap a room to change its status, see who is in it, who stayed and who cleaned it.
english: Tap a room to change its status, see who is in it, who stayed and who cleaned it.
arabic: اضغط على غرفة لتغيير حالتها ومعرفة من فيها ومن أقام فيها ومن نظّفها.
spanish: Toque una habitación para cambiar su estado, ver quién está en ella, quién se quedó y quién la limpió.
portuguese: Toque em um cômodo para alterar seu status, ver quem está nele, quem ficou e quem o limpou.

key: Tap an occupied room to post minibar or laundry.
english: Tap an occupied room to post minibar or laundry.
arabic: انقر غرفة مشغولة لترحيل ميني بار أو غسيل.
spanish: Toque una habitación ocupada para cargar los consumos del minibar o la lavandería al folio.
portuguese: Toque em um cômodo ocupado para colocar frigobar ou lavanderia.

spanish: Toque los artículos del menú para agregarlos.
portuguese: Toque nos itens de menu para adicionar.

key: Targets vs performance, and where the business comes from.
english: Targets vs performance, and where the business comes from.
spanish: Metas, resultados y origen del negocio.
portuguese: Metas versus desempenho e de onde vem o negócio.

key: Task deadlines, room turnover and laundry pricing.
english: Task deadlines, room turnover and laundry pricing.
arabic: مواعيد المهام وتجهيز الغرف وأسعار الغسيل.
spanish: Plazos de tareas, preparación de habitaciones y tarifas de lavandería.
portuguese: Prazos de tarefas, rotatividade de quartos e preços de lavanderia.

spanish: Aplicar impuesto a la tasa de alojamiento

key: Tax ID and guest ID checks through Kamra Connect.
english: Tax ID and guest ID checks through Kamra Connect.
arabic: التحقق من الرقم الضريبي وهوية الضيف عبر Kamra Connect.
spanish: Verificación fiscal y de documentos de huéspedes mediante Kamra Connect.
portuguese: Verificações de identificação fiscal e de hóspede por meio do Kamra Connect.

key: Tax labels, ID types, payment methods and the guest phone code follow it.
english: Tax labels, ID types, payment methods and the guest phone code follow it.
arabic: تتبعها مسميات الضرائب وأنواع الهوية وطرق الدفع ورمز هاتف الضيف.
spanish: Determina las etiquetas fiscales, documentos de identidad, medios de pago y prefijo telefónico de los huéspedes.
portuguese: Seguem-se etiquetas fiscais, tipos de identificação, métodos de pagamento e o código de telefone do hóspede.

key: Tax on the room rate. Outlet and service rates come from the country pack.
english: Tax on the room rate. Outlet and service rates come from the country pack.
arabic: الضريبة على سعر الغرفة. نسب المنافذ والخدمات تأتي من حزمة الدولة.
spanish: Impuesto sobre la tarifa de habitación. Los impuestos de puntos de venta y servicios se obtienen de la configuración del país.
portuguese: Imposto sobre a tarifa do quarto. As tarifas de saída e serviço vêm do pacote do país.

arabic: الضريبة المدفوعة عند شراء هذا الصنف.
spanish: Impuesto pagado al comprar este ingrediente.

key: Tell the guest the Wi-Fi, breakfast and check-out times. Print it or send it on WhatsApp.
english: Tell the guest the Wi-Fi, breakfast and check-out times. Print it or send it on WhatsApp.
arabic: أخبر الضيف بالواي فاي ومواعيد الإفطار وتسجيل المغادرة. اطبعها أو أرسلها عبر واتساب.
spanish: Informe al huésped los datos del wifi y los horarios de desayuno y salida. Imprima la información o envíela por WhatsApp.
portuguese: Informe ao hóspede os horários de Wi-Fi, café da manhã e check-out. Imprima ou envie no WhatsApp.

spanish: Código de idioma de las plantillas
Plantilla: enlace de registro de llegada

arabic: من عشر إلى خمس عشرة دقيقة

key: Test page sent. It prints on the kitchen screen set to print for {printer}.
english: Test page sent. It prints on the kitchen screen set to print for {printer}.
arabic: أُرسلت صفحة الاختبار. ستُطبع من شاشة المطبخ المعيّنة للطباعة إلى {printer}.
spanish: Página de prueba enviada. Se imprimirá desde la pantalla de cocina configurada para la impresora {printer}.
portuguese: Página de teste enviada. Ele é impresso na tela da cozinha configurada para imprimir para {printer}.

key: Thank the guest, hand over any deposit refund, and wish them a safe journey.
english: Thank the guest, hand over any deposit refund, and wish them a safe journey.
arabic: اشكر الضيف، وسلّمه أي مبلغ تأمين مسترد، وتمنَّ له رحلة آمنة.
spanish: Agradezca la visita al huésped, entregue el reembolso del depósito que corresponda y deséele buen viaje.
portuguese: Agradeça ao hóspede, entregue o reembolso do depósito e deseje-lhe uma boa viagem.

key: Thank you for staying with us, safe travels, and we hope to welcome you again.
english: Thank you for staying with us, safe travels, and we hope to welcome you again.
arabic: شكراً لإقامتك معنا، نتمنى لك رحلة آمنة ونأمل أن نستقبلك مجدداً.
spanish: Gracias por alojarse con nosotros. Le deseamos buen viaje y esperamos recibirle nuevamente.
portuguese: Obrigado por ficar conosco, boa viagem e esperamos recebê-lo novamente.

key: Thanks - our team will reach out about {name}.
english: Thanks - our team will reach out about {name}.
spanish: Gracias. Nuestro equipo se comunicará con usted sobre {name}.
portuguese: Obrigado. Nossa equipe entrará em contato sobre {name}.

key: That didn't go through. Please try again.
english: That didn't go through. Please try again.
arabic: لم تكتمل العملية. يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى.
spanish: La operación no se completó. Vuelva a intentarlo.
portuguese: Isso não aconteceu. Por favor, tente novamente.

key: That record wasn't found - it may have been removed.
english: That record wasn't found - it may have been removed.
arabic: لم يُعثر على هذا السجل، ربما تم حذفه.
spanish: No se encontró ese registro; es posible que se haya eliminado.
portuguese: Esse registro não foi encontrado – pode ter sido removido.

key: That room is another type. Use Upgrade or change type, so the price is shown first.
english: That room is another type. Use Upgrade or change type, so the price is shown first.
arabic: هذه الغرفة من نوع آخر. استخدم الترقية أو تغيير النوع ليظهر السعر أولًا.
spanish: Esa habitación es de otro tipo. Utilice Mejora de categoría o Cambiar tipo para ver primero el precio.
portuguese: Essa sala é de outro tipo. Use Upgrade ou altere o tipo, para que o preço seja mostrado primeiro.

key: That signature image is too large.
english: That signature image is too large.
spanish: La imagen de firma es demasiado grande.
portuguese: Essa imagem de assinatura é muito grande.

key: The 03:00 audit held the date. Clear the blockers and run End of Day, then print the pack.
english: The 03:00 audit held the date. Clear the blockers and run End of Day, then print the pack.
arabic: تدقيق الساعة 03:00 أوقف التاريخ. أزل العوائق وشغّل إقفال اليوم ثم اطبع الحزمة.
spanish: La auditoría de las 03:00 dejó la fecha en espera. Resuelva los bloqueos, ejecute el cierre del día e imprima el paquete.
portuguese: A auditoria das 03:00 manteve a data. Limpe os bloqueadores e execute o Fim do Dia, depois imprima o pacote.

key: The agent couldn't finish - check the AI key in Settings.
english: The agent couldn't finish - check the AI key in Settings.
arabic: تعذّر على الوكيل الإكمال. تحقق من مفتاح الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإعدادات.
spanish: El agente no pudo completar la solicitud. Revise la clave de IA en Configuración.
portuguese: O agente não conseguiu terminar. Verifique a chave AI em Configurações.

key: The audit continues and the no-show policy applies to whoever is still listed.
english: The audit continues and the no-show policy applies to whoever is still listed.
arabic: يستمر التدقيق وتُطبق سياسة عدم الحضور على من لا يزال مدرجًا.
spanish: La auditoría continúa y la política de no presentación se aplica a las llegadas que sigan pendientes.
portuguese: A auditoria continua e a política de não comparecimento se aplica a quem ainda estiver listado.

key: The audit posts as it stands.
english: The audit posts as it stands.
spanish: La auditoría registra los datos actuales.
portuguese: Os postos de auditoria tal como estão.

key: The balance stays on the departed folio.
english: The balance stays on the departed folio.
arabic: يبقى الرصيد على فاتورة الضيف المغادر.
spanish: El saldo permanece en el folio del huésped que ya salió.
portuguese: O saldo permanece na folha que partiu.

key: The bill against what's already been received.
english: The bill against what's already been received.
spanish: La cuenta, considerando los pagos ya recibidos.
portuguese: A conta contra o que já foi recebido.

key: The bill stays open into the next business date. Its sale is dated tomorrow, not today.
english: The bill stays open into the next business date. Its sale is dated tomorrow, not today.
arabic: تبقى الفاتورة مفتوحة حتى تاريخ العمل التالي. تُسجل مبيعاتها بتاريخ الغد لا اليوم.
spanish: La cuenta sigue abierta para la siguiente fecha operativa. La venta se registrará mañana.
portuguese: A fatura permanece aberta até a próxima data comercial. Sua venda está datada de amanhã, não de hoje.

key: The bills stay where they are posted.
english: The bills stay where they are posted.
spanish: Las cuentas permanecen en los folios donde se registraron.
portuguese: As contas ficam onde foram postadas.

key: The booking ended without a stay - nothing is owed.
english: The booking ended without a stay - nothing is owed.
arabic: انتهى الحجز دون إقامة، ولا يوجد مبلغ مستحق.
spanish: La reserva terminó sin estancia y no hay saldo pendiente.
portuguese: A reserva terminou sem estadia - nada é devido.

key: The browser could not open the print view.
english: The browser could not open the print view.
arabic: تعذّر على المتصفح فتح عرض الطباعة.
spanish: El navegador no pudo abrir la vista de impresión.
portuguese: O navegador não conseguiu abrir a visualização de impressão.

key: The business date is ahead of the server date. The audit for it can run once that day has started.
english: The business date is ahead of the server date. The audit for it can run once that day has started.
arabic: تاريخ العمل يسبق تاريخ الخادم. يمكن تشغيل التدقيق له عندما يبدأ ذلك اليوم.
spanish: La fecha operativa es posterior a la fecha del servidor. La auditoría puede ejecutarse cuando comience esa fecha.
portuguese: A data comercial está à frente da data do servidor. A auditoria pode ser executada assim que o dia começar.

key: The cashier has gone home: a manager counts the drawer with the envelope and closes it.
english: The cashier has gone home: a manager counts the drawer with the envelope and closes it.
arabic: غادر أمين الصندوق: يعدّ المدير الدرج مع الظرف ويغلقه.
spanish: Si el cajero ya se retiró, un gerente debe contar el efectivo junto con el sobre y cerrar la sesión.
portuguese: O caixa foi para casa: um gerente conta a gaveta com o envelope e fecha-a.

key: The changing room for the wedding party. Assigning one puts a room block on it, so it genuinely leaves the sellable inventory rather than living on a note.
english: The changing room for the wedding party. Assigning one puts a room block on it, so it genuinely leaves the sellable inventory rather than living on a note.
arabic: غرفة تبديل الملابس لموكب الزفاف. تخصيص غرفة يضع عليها حجبًا، فتخرج فعليًا من المخزون القابل للبيع بدلًا من الاكتفاء بملاحظة.
spanish: Vestidor para los participantes de la boda. Al asignar una habitación se bloquea su venta y se retira del inventario disponible.
portuguese: O vestiário da festa de casamento. Atribuir um coloca um bloco de espaço nele, de modo que realmente deixa o estoque vendável, em vez de viver com uma nota.

key: The chosen dishes, exploded through their recipes at
english: The chosen dishes, exploded through their recipes at
arabic: الأطباق المختارة مفصّلة حسب وصفاتها عند
spanish: Los platos seleccionados, desglosados según sus recetas para
portuguese: Os pratos escolhidos, explodiram em suas receitas em

key: The core of Kamra: taking bookings, checking guests in and out, billing. Always on.
english: The core of Kamra: taking bookings, checking guests in and out, billing. Always on.
arabic: أساس Kamra: استقبال الحجوزات، وتسجيل وصول الضيوف ومغادرتهم، والفوترة. مفعّل دائمًا.
spanish: Funciones principales de Kamra: reservas, registro de llegadas y salidas y facturación. Siempre activas.
portuguese: O núcleo do Kamra: receber reservas, fazer check-in e check-out de hóspedes, cobrança. Sempre ligado.

key: the Data Protection Board of India
english: the Data Protection Board of India
spanish: la Junta de Protección de Datos de la India
portuguese: o Conselho de Proteção de Dados da Índia

key: The deposit and damages were settled at the first close-out. Closing again records the covers only - bill anything further as a line on the function.
english: The deposit and damages were settled at the first close-out. Closing again records the covers only - bill anything further as a line on the function.
arabic: سُوّي التأمين والأضرار في الإغلاق الأول. الإغلاق مجددًا يسجّل عدد الأشخاص فقط، وأي رسوم إضافية تُضاف كبند على المناسبة.
spanish: El depósito y los daños se liquidaron en el primer cierre. Este cierre solo registra los comensales; agregue cualquier cargo adicional como una línea del evento.
portuguese: O depósito e os danos foram liquidados no primeiro encerramento. Fechar novamente registra apenas as capas - fature qualquer coisa adicional como uma linha na função.

key: The discount spreads pro-rata across the lines, so each keeps its own
english: The discount spreads pro-rata across the lines, so each keeps its own
arabic: يُوزَّع الخصم نسبيًا على البنود، ويحتفظ كل بند بنسبة
spanish: El descuento se distribuye proporcionalmente entre las líneas, conservando cada una su tasa de
portuguese: O desconto é distribuído proporcionalmente pelas linhas, de modo que cada uma mantém o seu

key: The duplicate's stays, bills and tickets move to
english: The duplicate's stays, bills and tickets move to
arabic: تنتقل إقامات النسخة المكررة وفواتيرها وتذاكرها إلى
spanish: Las estancias, cuentas y solicitudes del duplicado se transfieren a
portuguese: As estadias, contas e passagens da segunda via passam para

key: The final reports are printed after room and tax are posted.
english: The final reports are printed after room and tax are posted.
arabic: تُطبع التقارير النهائية بعد ترحيل الغرفة والضريبة.
spanish: Los informes finales se imprimen después de registrar los cargos de habitación e impuestos.
portuguese: Os relatórios finais são impressos após o lançamento do quarto e dos impostos.

key: The folio only has {amt} in credit - settle the bill first, or let the deposit cover it.
english: The folio only has {amt} in credit - settle the bill first, or let the deposit cover it.
arabic: رصيد الفاتورة الدائن {amt} فقط - سدّد الفاتورة أولًا، أو دع التأمين يغطيها.
spanish: El folio solo tiene {amt} de saldo a favor. Liquide la cuenta primero o use el depósito de garantía para cubrirla.
portuguese: O extrato só tem {amt} em crédito - liquide a conta primeiro ou deixe o depósito cobri-la.

key: The folio was invoiced before every night was posted. Open it and cancel the invoice, then check out.
english: The folio was invoiced before every night was posted. Open it and cancel the invoice, then check out.
arabic: أُصدرت الفاتورة الضريبية قبل ترحيل كل الليالي. افتح الفاتورة وألغِ الفاتورة الضريبية، ثم سجّل المغادرة.
spanish: El folio se facturó antes de registrar todas las noches. Ábralo, cancele la factura y luego registre la salida.
portuguese: O extrato foi faturado antes de cada noite ser postada. Abra-o e cancele a fatura, depois finalize a compra.

key: The folios add up to more than the payment.
english: The folios add up to more than the payment.
arabic: مجموع الفواتير أكبر من مبلغ الدفعة.
spanish: La suma de los folios supera el importe del pago.
portuguese: Os fólios somam mais do que o pagamento.

key: The front office and the room board disagree, for example a room occupied in one and vacant in the other.
english: The front office and the room board disagree, for example a room occupied in one and vacant in the other.
arabic: الاستقبال ولوحة الغرف غير متطابقين، مثل غرفة مشغولة في أحدهما وشاغرة في الآخر.
spanish: Recepción y el tablero de habitaciones muestran estados distintos; por ejemplo, una habitación aparece ocupada en uno y desocupada en el otro.
portuguese: A recepção e a diretoria dos quartos discordam, por exemplo, um quarto ocupado em um e vago no outro.

key: The full amount is paid online to confirm this booking.
english: The full amount is paid online to confirm this booking.
arabic: يُدفع المبلغ كاملًا عبر الإنترنت لتأكيد هذا الحجز.
spanish: Para confirmar la reserva, se paga el importe total en línea.
portuguese: O valor total é pago online para confirmar esta reserva.

key: The group account {v0} pays as agreed.
english: The group account {v0} pays as agreed.
spanish: La cuenta del grupo {v0} paga según lo acordado.
portuguese: A conta do grupo {v0} paga conforme combinado.

key: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guest. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
english: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guest. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
arabic: تتجاوز المجموعة السعة المحددة بـ {n} ضيف. يجب أن يؤكد العقار مشاركة الأسرّة والسعر.
spanish: El grupo supera la capacidad indicada por {n} persona. El alojamiento debe confirmar si es posible compartir camas y cuál sería el precio.
portuguese: O grupo excede a capacidade listada por {n} hóspede. A propriedade deverá confirmar o compartilhamento da cama e o preço.

key: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guests. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
english: The group exceeds the listed capacity by {n} guests. The property must confirm bed sharing and the price.
arabic: تتجاوز المجموعة السعة المحددة بـ {n} ضيوف. يجب أن يؤكد العقار مشاركة الأسرّة والسعر.
spanish: El grupo supera la capacidad indicada por {n} personas. El alojamiento debe confirmar si es posible compartir camas y cuál sería el precio.
portuguese: O grupo excede a capacidade listada em {n} hóspedes. A propriedade deverá confirmar o compartilhamento da cama e o preço.

key: The guest already signed (online or earlier). Continue, or ask them to sign again below.
english: The guest already signed (online or earlier). Continue, or ask them to sign again below.
arabic: وقع الضيف مسبقا (عبر الإنترنت أو من قبل). تابع، أو اطلب منه التوقيع مجددا أدناه.
spanish: El huésped ya firmó (en línea o antes). Continúe o pídales que firmen nuevamente a continuación.
portuguese: O hóspede já assinou (online ou anterior). Continue ou peça que assinem novamente abaixo.

key: The guest checked in online{when}. Check what they sent against the guest at the desk.
english: The guest checked in online{when}. Check what they sent against the guest at the desk.
arabic: سجل الضيف وصوله عبر الإنترنت{when}. طابق ما أرسله مع الضيف عند المكتب.
spanish: El huésped completó el registro de entrada en línea{when}. Verifique en recepción que los datos enviados correspondan al huésped.
portuguese: O hóspede fez check-in online{when}. Verifique as informações enviadas com o hóspede na recepção.

key: The guest folio is closed, so a charge can't be added here. Open the folio.
english: The guest folio is closed, so a charge can't be added here. Open the folio.
arabic: فاتورة الضيف مغلقة، لذا لا يمكن إضافة رسوم هنا. افتح الفاتورة.
spanish: El folio de huésped está cerrado, por lo que no se puede agregar un cargo aquí. Abre el folio.
portuguese: A conta do hóspede está fechada, portanto não é possível adicionar cobrança aqui. Abra o extrato.

key: The guest is already in house. Use Room move to change rooms.
english: The guest is already in house. Use Room move to change rooms.
arabic: الضيف مقيم بالفعل. استخدم نقل الغرفة لتغيير الغرفة.
spanish: El huésped ya está alojado. Utilice Cambio de habitación para trasladarlo.
portuguese: O hóspede já está hospedado. Use Troca de quarto para mudar de quarto.

key: The guest is in-house: the old room is marked Dirty for housekeeping.
english: The guest is in-house: the old room is marked Dirty for housekeeping.
arabic: النزيل مقيم: تُعلَّم الغرفة السابقة متسخة للتدبير المنزلي.
spanish: El huésped está alojado. La habitación anterior se marcará como sucia para que el personal de limpieza la atienda.
portuguese: O hóspede está hospedado: o quarto anterior foi marcado como Sujo para a governança.

key: The guest must know their ID is read by Kamra's verification partner
english: The guest must know their ID is read by Kamra's verification partner
arabic: يجب إعلام الضيف بأن شريك التحقق لدى Kamra سيقرأ هويته
spanish: El huésped debe saber que el socio de verificación de Kamra leerá su documento de identidad
portuguese: O hóspede deve saber que seu documento de identidade foi lido pelo parceiro de verificação da Kamra

key: The guest pays at the outlet. Outlets cannot post to this room.
english: The guest pays at the outlet. Outlets cannot post to this room.
arabic: يدفع الضيف في المنفذ. لا يمكن للمنافذ تحميل رسوم على هذه الغرفة.
spanish: El huésped paga en el punto de venta. Los puntos de venta no pueden cargar consumos a esta habitación.
portuguese: O hóspede paga no outlet. Os pontos de venda não podem postar nesta sala.

key: The guest signed the printed card
english: The guest signed the printed card
spanish: El huésped firmó la ficha impresa
portuguese: O hóspede assinou a ficha impressa

spanish: La cuenta del huésped está liquidada.
portuguese: A conta do hóspede está liquidada.

key: The guided check-in follows these steps in order. Required steps cannot be skipped, and the guest cannot be checked in until they are done.
english: The guided check-in follows these steps in order. Required steps cannot be skipped, and the guest cannot be checked in until they are done.
arabic: يتبع تسجيل الوصول الموجه هذه الخطوات بالترتيب. لا يمكن تخطي الخطوات المطلوبة، ولا يمكن تسجيل وصول الضيف حتى تنجز.
spanish: El check-in guiado sigue estos pasos en orden. No se pueden omitir los pasos requeridos y no se puede registrar al huésped hasta que haya terminado.
portuguese: O check-in guiado segue estes passos em ordem. As etapas necessárias não podem ser ignoradas e o hóspede não poderá fazer check-in até que seja concluído.

key: The guided check-in follows these steps. Only Room must be done before check-in. Other required steps can finish after the guest is in — the desk sees a warning to backfill.
english: The guided check-in follows these steps. Only Room must be done before check-in. Other required steps can finish after the guest is in — the desk sees a warning to backfill.
arabic: يتبع تسجيل الوصول الموجّه هذه الخطوات. الغرفة وحدها يجب إنجازها قبل تسجيل الوصول. يمكن إكمال الخطوات المطلوبة الأخرى بعد دخول النزيل — يرى المكتب تنبيهاً لاستكمالها.
portuguese: O check-in guiado segue estes passos. Apenas o quarto deve ser feito antes do check-in. Outras etapas obrigatórias podem ser concluídas após a entrada do hóspede – o balcão recebe um aviso para preenchimento.

key: The guided check-in follows these steps. Only Room must be done before check-in. Other required steps can finish after the guest is in; the desk sees a warning to backfill.
english: The guided check-in follows these steps. Only Room must be done before check-in. Other required steps can finish after the guest is in; the desk sees a warning to backfill.
arabic: يتبع تسجيل الوصول الموجّه هذه الخطوات. الغرفة وحدها يجب إنجازها قبل تسجيل الوصول. يمكن إكمال الخطوات المطلوبة الأخرى بعد دخول النزيل؛ ويرى المكتب تنبيهاً لاستكمالها.
spanish: El check-in guiado sigue estos pasos. Solo Habitación debe completarse antes del check-in. Los demás pasos obligatorios pueden terminarse después de que el huésped entre; recepción verá un aviso para completarlos.
portuguese: O check-in guiado segue estes passos. Apenas o quarto deve ser feito antes do check-in. Outras etapas obrigatórias podem ser concluídas após a entrada do hóspede; a mesa vê um aviso para preencher.

key: The hall's rack rental goes on as the first line - the number the conversation starts from.
english: The hall's rack rental goes on as the first line - the number the conversation starts from.
arabic: إيجار القاعة الأساسي يُضاف كأول بند - الرقم الذي تبدأ منه المحادثة.
spanish: La tarifa base de alquiler del salón se agrega como primera línea y sirve de punto de partida para la cotización.
portuguese: O aluguel do rack do salão continua como a primeira linha - o número a partir do qual a conversa começa.

spanish: La verificación de saldo alto está desactivada (umbral 0).
portuguese: A verificação de saldo alto está desativada (limite 0).

key: The hotel default is the standard layout again.
english: The hotel default is the standard layout again.
arabic: عاد الإعداد الافتراضي للفندق إلى التخطيط القياسي.
spanish: El diseño predeterminado del hotel vuelve a ser el estándar.
portuguese: O padrão do hotel é o layout padrão novamente.

key: The hotel keeps a copy of your ID with its registration records.
english: The hotel keeps a copy of your ID with its registration records.
arabic: يحتفظ الفندق بنسخة من هويتك مع سجلات التسجيل.
spanish: El hotel conserva una copia de su documento de identidad en el registro de huéspedes.
portuguese: O hotel guarda uma cópia do seu documento de identificação com os registos de registo.

key: The hotel's billing rules pick the folio, and food and drink take the hotel's food tax rate.
english: The hotel's billing rules pick the folio, and food and drink take the hotel's food tax rate.
arabic: قواعد الفوترة في الفندق تختار الفاتورة، والطعام والشراب يأخذان نسبة ضريبة الطعام في الفندق.
spanish: Las reglas de facturación determinan el folio al que se cargan los consumos. A los alimentos y bebidas se les aplica la tasa de impuesto configurada para ellos.
portuguese: As regras de cobrança do hotel escolhem o extrato, e alimentos e bebidas cobram a taxa de imposto alimentar do hotel.

key: The inspection task is due this long after the clean is done.
english: The inspection task is due this long after the clean is done.
arabic: موعد مهمة الفحص بعد هذه المدة من انتهاء التنظيف.
spanish: La inspección vence una vez transcurrido este tiempo desde que termina la limpieza.
portuguese: A tarefa de inspeção deve ser realizada muito depois de a limpeza ser concluída.

key: The Kamra version this site is running
english: The Kamra version this site is running
arabic: إصدار Kamra الذي يعمل عليه هذا الموقع
spanish: La versión de Kamra que ejecuta este sitio
portuguese: A versão Kamra que este site está executando

key: The key stays on your server, stored masked. Usage is billed to your own provider account.
english: The key stays on your server, stored masked. Usage is billed to your own provider account.
arabic: يبقى المفتاح على خادمك محفوظًا بشكل مخفي. يُفوتر الاستخدام على حسابك لدى المزوّد.
spanish: La clave permanece oculta en su servidor. El consumo se factura a su cuenta del proveedor de IA.
portuguese: A chave permanece no seu servidor, armazenada mascarada. O uso é cobrado em sua própria conta de provedor.

key: The kitchen already has {n} item(s). They are voided, not deleted: the kitchen is told to stop, and a supervisor approves.
english: The kitchen already has {n} item(s). They are voided, not deleted: the kitchen is told to stop, and a supervisor approves.
arabic: لدى المطبخ {n} صنف بالفعل. تُبطل ولا تُحذف: يُبلَّغ المطبخ بالتوقف، ويوافق مشرف.
spanish: La cocina ya recibió {n} artículo(s). Se anulan, no se eliminan: se avisa a la cocina que deje de prepararlos y un supervisor debe aprobar la anulación.
portuguese: A cozinha já possui {n} item(s). Eles são anulados, não excluídos: a cozinha é instruída a parar e um supervisor aprova.

key: The kitchen store cupboard - name, unit, category and cost. Stock movements live under Kitchen Inventory; recipes under Menu → Recipes.
english: The kitchen store cupboard - name, unit, category and cost. Stock movements live under Kitchen Inventory; recipes under Menu → Recipes.
arabic: مخزن المطبخ: الاسم والوحدة والفئة والتكلفة. حركات المخزون في مخزون المطبخ، والوصفات في القائمة → الوصفات.
spanish: Almacén de cocina: nombre, unidad, categoría y costo. Los movimientos están en Inventario de cocina y las recetas en Menú → Recetas.
portuguese: Armário de cozinha - nome, unidade, categoria e custo. Os movimentos de estoque ficam em Inventário de Cozinha; receitas em Menu → Receitas.

key: The lock system did not answer. Make the keys at the encoder.
english: The lock system did not answer. Make the keys at the encoder.
arabic: لم يستجب نظام الأقفال. أنشئ المفاتيح من جهاز الترميز.
spanish: El sistema de cerraduras no respondió. Programe las llaves en el codificador.
portuguese: O sistema de bloqueio não respondeu. Faça as chaves no codificador.

key: The menus and services every quote is built from.
english: The menus and services every quote is built from.
arabic: القوائم والخدمات التي يُبنى عليها كل عرض سعر.
spanish: Menús y servicios utilizados para preparar las cotizaciones.
portuguese: Os menus e serviços a partir dos quais cada cotação é construída.

key: The minimum they pay for - menus bill on this
english: The minimum they pay for - menus bill on this
arabic: الحد الأدنى المدفوع: تُفوتر القوائم على أساسه
spanish: Cantidad mínima facturable: los menús se cobran según este número
portuguese: O mínimo que pagam - os menus cobram por isso

key: The mismatch stays and may show up as a wrong room status tomorrow.
english: The mismatch stays and may show up as a wrong room status tomorrow.
arabic: يبقى عدم التطابق وقد يظهر كحالة غرفة خاطئة غدًا.
spanish: La discrepancia permanece y puede mostrar un estado de habitación incorrecto mañana.
portuguese: A incompatibilidade permanece e pode aparecer como um status de quarto errado amanhã.

key: The night audit already closed {d}, but the business date did not move. Advance it without posting again.
english: The night audit already closed {d}, but the business date did not move. Advance it without posting again.
arabic: أغلق التدقيق الليلي {d} بالفعل، لكن تاريخ العمل لم يتقدم. قدّمه دون ترحيل مرة أخرى.
spanish: La auditoría nocturna ya cerró el {d}, pero la fecha operativa no se actualizó. Aváncela sin volver a contabilizar los movimientos.
portuguese: A auditoria noturna já encerrou {d}, mas a data do negócio não mudou. Avance sem postar novamente.

key: The night audit holds this arrival as Due In instead of marking a no-show; the next audit decides.
english: The night audit holds this arrival as Due In instead of marking a no-show; the next audit decides.
arabic: يُبقي التدقيق الليلي هذا الوصول كمتوقع الوصول بدلًا من تسجيله كعدم حضور، ويقرر التدقيق التالي.
spanish: La auditoría nocturna mantiene esta llegada como Pendiente de entrada en lugar de marcarla como no presentada; se resuelve en la siguiente auditoría.
portuguese: A auditoria noturna considera esta chegada como Vencida em vez de marcar um não comparecimento; a próxima auditoria decide.

key: The numbered rooms the front desk assigns.
english: The numbered rooms the front desk assigns.
spanish: Habitaciones numeradas que asigna el personal de recepción.
portuguese: Os quartos numerados que a recepção atribui.

key: The online booking page can run alongside a channel manager or on its own.
english: The online booking page can run alongside a channel manager or on its own.
arabic: يمكن تشغيل صفحة الحجز الإلكتروني مع مدير القنوات أو بمفردها.
spanish: La página de reservas en línea puede funcionar junto con un gestor de canales o de forma independiente.
portuguese: A página de reservas online pode ser executada junto com um gerenciador de canal ou por conta própria.

key: The OTA paid the room and nothing is held for extras. Blocking charges to the room is safer.
english: The OTA paid the room and nothing is held for extras. Blocking charges to the room is safer.
arabic: دفعت وكالة الحجز ثمن الغرفة ولا يوجد مبلغ محجوز للإضافات. منع الرسوم على الغرفة أكثر أمانا.
spanish: La OTA pagó la habitación y no se retiene nada para extras. Bloquear cargos a la habitación es más seguro.
portuguese: A OTA pagou o quarto e nada é retido para extras. Bloquear cobranças no quarto é mais seguro.

key: The payment-link gateway for advances and folio settlement.
english: The payment-link gateway for advances and folio settlement.
arabic: بوابة روابط الدفع للدفعات المقدمة وتسوية الفواتير.
spanish: Pasarela de enlaces de pago para anticipos y liquidación de folios.
portuguese: O gateway de link de pagamento para adiantamentos e liquidação de contas.

key: The pre-checks are loaded. Work through the steps, then post room and tax to close the business date.
english: The pre-checks are loaded. Work through the steps, then post room and tax to close the business date.
arabic: تم تحميل الفحوص المسبقة. راجع الخطوات ثم رحّل الغرفة والضريبة لإغلاق تاريخ العمل.
spanish: Se cargaron las comprobaciones previas. Complete los pasos y luego registre los cargos de habitación e impuestos para cerrar la fecha operativa.
portuguese: As pré-verificações são carregadas. Siga as etapas e, em seguida, publique o quarto e os impostos para fechar a data comercial.

key: The property cannot accommodate the number of people requested.
english: The property cannot accommodate the number of people requested.
arabic: لا يستطيع العقار استيعاب عدد الأشخاص المطلوب.
spanish: El alojamiento no puede recibir a la cantidad de personas solicitada.
portuguese: A propriedade não pode acomodar o número de pessoas solicitadas.

key: The public /book page: on or off, how it confirms and how guests pay.
english: The public /book page: on or off, how it confirms and how guests pay.
arabic: صفحة /book العامة: تفعيلها أو إيقافها، وطريقة التأكيد، وطريقة دفع الضيوف.
spanish: Página pública /book: activación, confirmación de reservas y pagos de huéspedes.
portuguese: A página pública/livro: ligada ou desligada, como confirma e como os hóspedes pagam.

key: The quote, the schedule, the policy and the signature blocks.
english: The quote, the schedule, the policy and the signature blocks.
arabic: عرض السعر وجدول الدفعات والسياسة وخانات التوقيع.
spanish: Cotización, calendario de pagos, políticas y espacios para firmas.
portuguese: A cotação, o cronograma, a apólice e os blocos de assinatura.

key: The reason is what makes the pipeline worth reading later.
english: The reason is what makes the pipeline worth reading later.
arabic: السبب هو ما يجعل مسار الفرص مفيدًا للمراجعة لاحقًا.
spanish: El motivo permite interpretar después el seguimiento de oportunidades.
portuguese: O motivo é o que faz valer a pena ler o pipeline mais tarde.

key: The region sets the currency, time zone, tax words and invoice format, ID types and payment methods. Time zone decides when your business day rolls over.
english: The region sets the currency, time zone, tax words and invoice format, ID types and payment methods. Time zone decides when your business day rolls over.
arabic: تحدد المنطقة العملة والمنطقة الزمنية ومسميات الضرائب وتنسيق الفاتورة وأنواع الهوية وطرق الدفع. تحدد المنطقة الزمنية موعد انتقال يوم العمل.
spanish: La región determina la moneda, la zona horaria, los términos fiscales, el formato de las facturas, los tipos de documento de identidad y los métodos de pago. La zona horaria determina cuándo cambia la fecha operativa.
portuguese: A região define a moeda, o fuso horário, as palavras fiscais e o formato da fatura, os tipos de ID e os métodos de pagamento. O fuso horário decide quando seu dia útil termina.

key: The remaining nights could not be posted.
english: The remaining nights could not be posted.
spanish: No se pudieron registrar las noches pendientes.
portuguese: As noites restantes não puderam ser postadas.

spanish: Las comandas restantes se imprimieron aquí.

key: The room is still occupied. Check the current guest out first.
english: The room is still occupied. Check the current guest out first.
arabic: الغرفة ما زالت مشغولة. سجّل مغادرة النزيل الحالي أولًا.
spanish: La habitación sigue ocupada. Registre primero la salida del huésped actual.
portuguese: O quarto ainda está ocupado. Faça o check-out do hóspede atual primeiro.

key: The running sheet the banquet, kitchen and AV teams work from.
english: The running sheet the banquet, kitchen and AV teams work from.
arabic: ورقة التشغيل التي تعمل بها فرق المآدب والمطبخ والصوت والصورة.
spanish: Hoja de trabajo para los equipos de banquetes, cocina y audiovisuales.
portuguese: A planilha a partir da qual as equipes de banquete, cozinha e AV trabalham.

spanish: la Autoridad Saudí de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial (SDAIA)
portuguese: a Autoridade Saudita de Dados e IA (SDAIA)

key: The security deposit of {v0}{v1} still held counts toward the bill; check-out records it as applied.
english: The security deposit of {v0}{v1} still held counts toward the bill; check-out records it as applied.
arabic: يُحتسب مبلغ التأمين المحتجز {v0}{v1} ضمن الفاتورة، ويسجّله تسجيل المغادرة كمطبّق.
spanish: El depósito de garantía retenido de {v0}{v1} se aplica a la cuenta al registrar la salida.
portuguese: A caução de {v0}{v1} ainda retida conta para a fatura; o check-out a registra como aplicada.

key: The slot must end after it starts.
english: The slot must end after it starts.
arabic: يجب أن تنتهي الفترة بعد بدايتها.
spanish: La franja horaria debe terminar después de su hora de inicio.
portuguese: O slot deve terminar depois de começar.

key: The stay is left in house past its departure and tonight is not charged for it. Use only if someone will fix it first thing.
english: The stay is left in house past its departure and tonight is not charged for it. Use only if someone will fix it first thing.
arabic: تبقى الإقامة داخل الفندق بعد موعد مغادرتها ولا تُحتسب الليلة. استخدمه فقط إذا سيتم تصحيحها أول الصباح.
spanish: La estancia permanece ocupada después de su salida prevista y no se cobra esta noche. Úselo solo si se corregirá a primera hora.
portuguese: A estadia permanece como hospedada após a data de saída e a noite de hoje não é cobrada. Use apenas se alguém for ajustar na primeira hora.

key: The till stays open and rolls into tomorrow with its float and takings. Variance is not recorded for tonight.
english: The till stays open and rolls into tomorrow with its float and takings. Variance is not recorded for tonight.
arabic: يبقى الصندوق مفتوحًا وينتقل إلى الغد برصيده الافتتاحي ومتحصلاته. لا يُسجل فارق لهذه الليلة.
spanish: La caja continúa abierta mañana con su fondo y recaudación. No se registra una diferencia para esta noche.
portuguese: A caixa registradora permanece aberta e rola até amanhã com seu carro alegórico e receitas. A variação não foi registrada para esta noite.

key: The time window on the day-use / hourly tape.
english: The time window on the day-use / hourly tape.
arabic: النافذة الزمنية في مخطط الاستخدام اليومي / بالساعة.
spanish: Intervalo de la vista de uso diurno o por horas.
portuguese: A janela de tempo na fita de uso diário/hora.

spanish: la Oficina de Datos de los Emiratos Árabes Unidos
portuguese: o Gabinete de Dados dos EAU

key: The whole portfolio at a glance.
english: The whole portfolio at a glance.
spanish: Todo el portafolio de un vistazo.

key: Theme and language for this browser.
english: Theme and language for this browser.
spanish: Tema e idioma para este navegador.
portuguese: Tema e idioma para este navegador.

key: Then recreate the stack / run migrate. Nightly channel
english: Then recreate the stack / run migrate. Nightly channel
arabic: ثم أعد إنشاء المكدس / نفّذ migrate. قناة Nightly
spanish: Después vuelva a crear los contenedores o ejecute la migración. Canal de compilaciones diarias
portuguese: Em seguida, recrie a pilha/execute a migração. Canal noturno

key: These apply to this device only.
english: These apply to this device only.
arabic: تنطبق هذه الإعدادات على هذا الجهاز فقط.
spanish: Estos se aplican únicamente a este dispositivo.
portuguese: Estas aplicam-se apenas a este dispositivo.

key: These dates require a minimum stay of {n} night.
english: These dates require a minimum stay of {n} night.
arabic: تتطلب هذه التواريخ حدًا أدنى للإقامة {n} ليلة.
spanish: Estas fechas requieren una estancia mínima de {n} noche.
portuguese: Estas datas exigem uma estadia mínima de {n} noite.

key: These dates require a minimum stay of {n} nights.
english: These dates require a minimum stay of {n} nights.
arabic: تتطلب هذه التواريخ حدًا أدنى للإقامة {n} ليالٍ.
spanish: Estas fechas requieren una estancia mínima de {n} noches.
portuguese: Estas datas exigem uma estadia mínima de {n} noites.

key: They confirmed by phone, email, or WhatsApp - record it here. No guest portal.
english: They confirmed by phone, email, or WhatsApp - record it here. No guest portal.
arabic: أكدوا عبر الهاتف أو البريد الإلكتروني أو WhatsApp، سجّل ذلك هنا. لا توجد بوابة للضيف.
spanish: Confirmaron por teléfono, correo electrónico o WhatsApp. Regístrelo aquí; no se utiliza un portal del huésped.
portuguese: Eles confirmaram por telefone, e-mail ou WhatsApp – registre aqui. Nenhum portal de hóspedes.

key: They sign in with this email.
english: They sign in with this email.
spanish: Inician sesión con este correo electrónico.
portuguese: Eles fazem login com este e-mail.

key: This arrival is due on {v0}, after the business date {v1}.
english: This arrival is due on {v0}, after the business date {v1}.
arabic: موعد هذا الوصول {v0}، بعد تاريخ العمل {v1}.
spanish: Esta llegada corresponde al {v0}, después de la fecha operativa {v1}.
portuguese: Esta chegada está prevista para {v0}, após a data comercial {v1}.

key: This blocks the audit. Fix it above, or override it with a reason - your name and the time are recorded on the audit.
english: This blocks the audit. Fix it above, or override it with a reason - your name and the time are recorded on the audit.
arabic: هذا يوقف التدقيق. أصلحه أعلاه، أو تجاوزه مع ذكر السبب، ويُسجل اسمك والوقت في التدقيق.
spanish: Esto bloquea la auditoría. Resuélvalo en la sección anterior o autorice una excepción indicando el motivo. Su nombre y la hora quedarán registrados en la auditoría.
portuguese: Isso bloqueia a auditoria. Corrija-o acima ou substitua-o por um motivo - seu nome e o horário são registrados na auditoria.

key: This blocks the audit. Resolve it, or acknowledge it with a reason - your name and the time are recorded on the audit.
english: This blocks the audit. Resolve it, or acknowledge it with a reason - your name and the time are recorded on the audit.
arabic: هذا يوقف التدقيق. عالجه أو أقرّ به مع ذكر السبب - يُسجّل اسمك والوقت في التدقيق.
spanish: Esto bloquea la auditoría. Resuélvalo o confirme la revisión indicando el motivo. Su nombre y la hora quedarán registrados en la auditoría.
portuguese: Isso bloqueia a auditoria. Resolva ou indique um motivo - seu nome e o horário ficam registrados na auditoria.

key: This booking has no company. Add the company to the booking first.
english: This booking has no company. Add the company to the booking first.
arabic: لا توجد شركة في هذا الحجز. أضف الشركة إلى الحجز أولًا.
spanish: Esta reserva no tiene empresa. Agréguela primero a la reserva.
portuguese: Esta reserva não tem companhia. Adicione a empresa à reserva primeiro.

key: This booking has no guest profile.
english: This booking has no guest profile.
arabic: لا يوجد ملف ضيف لهذا الحجز.
spanish: Esta reserva no tiene perfil de huésped.
portuguese: Esta reserva não possui perfil de hóspede.

key: This booking is not part of a group.
english: This booking is not part of a group.
spanish: Esta reserva no forma parte de un grupo.
portuguese: Esta reserva não faz parte de um grupo.

key: This browser cannot use a camera here. Upload a picture instead.
english: This browser cannot use a camera here. Upload a picture instead.
arabic: لا يمكن لهذا المتصفح استخدام الكاميرا هنا. ارفع صورة بدلًا من ذلك.
spanish: Este navegador no puede utilizar una cámara aquí. Sube una foto en su lugar.
portuguese: Este navegador não pode usar uma câmera aqui. Em vez disso, carregue uma foto.

key: This change re-prices the stay from {from} to {to}. Confirm the new price?
english: This change re-prices the stay from {from} to {to}. Confirm the new price?
arabic: هذا التغيير يعيد تسعير الإقامة من {from} إلى {to}. هل تؤكد السعر الجديد؟
spanish: Este cambio modifica el total de la estancia de {from} a {to}. ¿Confirma el nuevo precio?
portuguese: Esta alteração revaloriza a estadia de {from} para {to}. Confirmar o novo preço?

key: This check-in link isn't valid. Please contact the hotel.
english: This check-in link isn't valid. Please contact the hotel.
arabic: رابط تسجيل الوصول هذا غير صالح. يرجى التواصل مع الفندق.
spanish: Este enlace de registro de entrada ya no es válido. Ponte en contacto con el alojamiento.
portuguese: Este link de check-in não é válido. Por favor, entre em contato com o hotel.

key: This checks out {name} only. Check out the others one at a time when they leave.
english: This checks out {name} only. Check out the others one at a time when they leave.
arabic: هذا يسجل مغادرة {name} فقط. سجّل مغادرة الآخرين واحداً تلو الآخر عند مغادرتهم.
spanish: Esto registra la salida únicamente de {name}. Registre la salida de los demás huéspedes por separado cuando se retiren.
portuguese: Isso realiza o check-out apenas de {name}. Faça o check-out dos demais um a um quando saírem.

key: This closes the bag without billing. Tell us why - it's recorded on the order.
english: This closes the bag without billing. Tell us why - it's recorded on the order.
arabic: يغلق هذا الحقيبة دون فوترة. أخبرنا لماذا - يُسجَّل على الطلب.
spanish: Esto cierra la orden de lavandería sin facturar. Indique el motivo; quedará registrado en la orden.
portuguese: Isso fecha o saco sem faturar. Diga-nos o porquê - está registrado no pedido.
Isto confirma que a sua reserva

key: This dish never touches inventory. That's a valid choice - most menus only ever cost their big movers.
english: This dish never touches inventory. That's a valid choice - most menus only ever cost their big movers.
arabic: هذا الطبق لا يؤثر في المخزون. هذا خيار صحيح، فمعظم القوائم تحسب تكلفة أصنافها الأكثر مبيعًا فقط.
spanish: Este plato no descuenta inventario. Es una opción válida; muchos menús solo calculan los costos de sus platos de mayor venta.
portuguese: Este prato nunca toca no inventário. Essa é uma escolha válida - a maioria dos menus custa apenas seus grandes impulsionadores.

spanish: Este huésped está en la lista negra
portuguese: Este hóspede está na lista restrita (blacklist)

spanish: Esta es una factura generada por computadora.
portuguese: Esta é uma fatura gerada por computador.

key: This is a computer-generated tax invoice under the GST Act.
english: This is a computer-generated tax invoice under the GST Act.
arabic: هذه فاتورة ضريبية مولّدة حاسوبياً بموجب قانون GST.
spanish: Esta factura fiscal se generó electrónicamente conforme a la ley del GST.
portuguese: Esta é uma fatura fiscal gerada por computador de acordo com a Lei GST.

key: This module is off, so its apps are hidden for everyone. Settings are kept for when you switch it back on.
english: This module is off, so its apps are hidden for everyone. Settings are kept for when you switch it back on.
arabic: هذه الوحدة متوقفة، لذا تطبيقاتها مخفية عن الجميع. تُحفظ الإعدادات لحين إعادة تفعيلها.
spanish: Este módulo está desactivado y sus aplicaciones están ocultas para todos. La configuración se conserva para cuando vuelva a activarlo.
portuguese: Este módulo está desativado, portanto seus aplicativos ficam ocultos para todos. As configurações são mantidas para quando você ligá-lo novamente.

key: This package has no dishes attached yet - add them to its courses under Menus & Services, and the customer can start choosing.
english: This package has no dishes attached yet - add them to its courses under Menus & Services, and the customer can start choosing.
arabic: لا توجد أطباق مرتبطة بهذه الباقة بعد. أضفها إلى مراحل التقديم في القوائم والخدمات ليبدأ العميل الاختيار.
spanish: Este paquete aún no tiene platos asociados. Agréguelos a sus tiempos en Menús y servicios para que el cliente pueda elegir.
portuguese: Este pacote ainda não possui pratos anexados - adicione-os aos seus pratos em Menus e Serviços e o cliente pode começar a escolher.

key: This posts tonight's room and tax for every in-house guest, applies the no-show policy, saves the audit pack and rolls the business date from {bd}. It cannot be undone.
english: This posts tonight's room and tax for every in-house guest, applies the no-show policy, saves the audit pack and rolls the business date from {bd}. It cannot be undone.
arabic: يرحّل هذا غرفة وضريبة الليلة لكل نزيل مقيم، ويطبّق سياسة عدم الحضور، ويحفظ حزمة التدقيق وينقل تاريخ العمل من {bd}. لا يمكن التراجع عنه.
spanish: Esto registra los cargos de habitación e impuestos de esta noche para cada huésped alojado, aplica la política de huéspedes no presentados, guarda el paquete de auditoría y avanza la fecha operativa desde {bd}. Esta acción no se puede deshacer.
portuguese: Isso lança a diária e impostos desta noite para cada hóspede no hotel, aplica a política de no-show, salva o pacote de auditoria e avança a data de negócios de {bd}. Não pode ser desfeito.

key: This property deletes ID scans at checkout and keeps only the last 4 digits. The profile keeps the type, dates and that the ID was verified. Ask for the ID again on a new stay.
english: This property deletes ID scans at checkout and keeps only the last 4 digits. The profile keeps the type, dates and that the ID was verified. Ask for the ID again on a new stay.
arabic: يحذف هذا العقار صور الهوية عند المغادرة ويحتفظ بآخر 4 أرقام فقط. يحتفظ الملف بالنوع والتواريخ وبأن الهوية جرى التحقق منها. اطلب الهوية مجددًا عند إقامة جديدة.
spanish: Este alojamiento elimina las imágenes de documentos de identidad al registrar la salida y conserva solo los últimos cuatro dígitos. El perfil guarda el tipo de documento, las fechas y que fue verificado. Solicite el documento nuevamente en la próxima estancia.
portuguese: Esta propriedade exclui digitalizações de documentos no check-out e mantém apenas os últimos 4 dígitos. O perfil mantém o tipo, datas e a confirmação de verificação. Solicite novamente o documento em uma nova estadia.

key: This property only - switch hotel in the header to see another.
english: This property only - switch hotel in the header to see another.
arabic: هذا العقار فقط. بدّل الفندق من الترويسة لعرض غيره.
spanish: Solo este alojamiento. Cambie de hotel en el encabezado para consultar otro.
portuguese: Somente esta propriedade: troque de hotel no cabeçalho para ver outro.

key: This room is not cleaned yet. Pick a clean room, or ask housekeeping first.
english: This room is not cleaned yet. Pick a clean room, or ask housekeeping first.
arabic: هذه الغرفة لم تنظف بعد. اختر غرفة نظيفة، أو اسأل التدبير المنزلي أولا.
spanish: Esta habitación aún no se ha limpiado. Elija una habitación limpia o pregunte primero al servicio de limpieza.
portuguese: Este quarto ainda não foi limpo. Escolha um quarto limpo ou peça primeiro ao serviço de limpeza.

key: This sets currency {currency}, time zone {tz}, and {tax} invoices.
english: This sets currency {currency}, time zone {tz}, and {tax} invoices.
arabic: يحدد هذا العملة {currency} والمنطقة الزمنية {tz} وفواتير {tax}.
spanish: Configura la moneda {currency}, la zona horaria {tz} y las facturas con {tax}.
portuguese: Isso define faturas de moeda {currency}, fuso horário {tz} e {tax}.

key: This stay is {v0}, so there is nothing to check out.
english: This stay is {v0}, so there is nothing to check out.
arabic: حالة هذه الإقامة {v0}، فلا توجد مغادرة لتسجيلها.
spanish: Esta estancia está en estado {v0}; no hay una salida que registrar.
portuguese: Esta estadia é {v0}, portanto não há nada para fazer check-out.

key: This step is not finished yet.
english: This step is not finished yet.
spanish: Este paso aún no está completo.
portuguese: Esta etapa ainda não foi concluída.

key: This type is full tonight - try another room type.
english: This type is full tonight - try another room type.
arabic: هذا النوع ممتلئ الليلة - جرّب نوع غرفة آخر.
spanish: No hay disponibilidad de este tipo de habitación para esta noche. Pruebe con otro tipo.
portuguese: Este tipo está lotado esta noite - tente outro tipo de quarto.

key: Tick Credit allowed and save to bill this company on the city ledger.
english: Tick Credit allowed and save to bill this company on the city ledger.
arabic: حدد «الائتمان مسموح» واحفظ لفوترة هذه الشركة على دفتر المدينة.
spanish: Marque «Crédito permitido» y guarde los cambios para facturar a esta empresa en su cuenta por cobrar.
portuguese: Marque Crédito permitido e salve para faturar esta empresa no livro-razão da cidade.

key: Tick the confirmation above to continue.
english: Tick the confirmation above to continue.
arabic: ضع علامة على التأكيد أعلاه للمتابعة.
spanish: Marque la confirmación anterior para continuar.
portuguese: Marque a confirmação acima para continuar.

key: Tick the lines moving to the new bill.
english: Tick the lines moving to the new bill.
arabic: حدد البنود المنقولة إلى الفاتورة الجديدة.
spanish: Marque las líneas que desea trasladar a la nueva cuenta.
portuguese: Marque as linhas que passam para a nova fatura.

key: Tick to deactivate; clear to activate
english: Tick to deactivate; clear to activate
arabic: حدد لإلغاء التفعيل؛ أزل التحديد للتفعيل
spanish: Marque para desactivar; desmarque para activar
portuguese: Marque para desativar; limpe para ativar

key: Tick to unpublish; clear to activate at booking
english: Tick to unpublish; clear to activate at booking
arabic: حدد لإلغاء النشر؛ أزل التحديد للتفعيل عند الحجز
spanish: Marque para retirar de publicación; desmarque para ofrecerlo al reservar
portuguese: Marque para cancelar a publicação; claro para ativar na reserva

key: Ticked charge types post to the Company folio on corporate stays. Everything else - and alcohol, always - bills to the guest.

portuguese: Já temos isso da sua última visita - vamos usá-lo. Adicione uma foto abaixo apenas para substituí-la por uma mais recente.

key: We've saved your number; the front desk will reach out with payment details and before arrival.
english: We've saved your number; the front desk will reach out with payment details and before arrival.
arabic: حفظنا رقمك، وسيتواصل معك الاستقبال بتفاصيل الدفع وقبل وصولك.

portuguese: Salvamos seu número; a recepção entrará em contato com os detalhes de pagamento antes da chegada.

spanish: Precio por noche de fin de semana (opcional)
portuguese: Preço por noite de fim de semana (opcional)

portuguese: Fui a um concorrente por preço/data de mudança/evento cancelado…

key: Were there any restaurant or minibar charges we should check?

key: What came in, and what happened to it
english: What came in, and what happened to it

english: What did you count, and why does it differ? (required)
spanish: ¿Qué contó y por qué hay una diferencia? (obligatorio)
portuguese: O que você contou e por que é diferente? (obrigatório)

key: What does today look like - arrivals, departures, occupancy?
english: What does today look like - arrivals, departures, occupancy?
arabic: كيف يبدو اليوم: الوصول والمغادرة والإشغال؟
spanish: ¿Cómo está el día de hoy: llegadas, salidas y ocupación?
portuguese: Como está o dia de hoje – chegadas, saídas, ocupação?

key: What each dish takes off its outlet's stock when the kitchen fires it.
english: What each dish takes off its outlet's stock when the kitchen fires it.
arabic: ما يخصمه كل طبق من مخزون منفذه عند إرساله للمطبخ.
spanish: Ingredientes que se descuentan del inventario del punto de venta al iniciar la preparación de cada plato.
portuguese: O que cada prato tira do estoque do seu ponto de venda quando a cozinha o dispara.

key: What each room costs per night, and what moved it.
english: What each room costs per night, and what moved it.
arabic: سعر كل غرفة لليلة الواحدة، وما الذي غيّره.
spanish: La tarifa de cada habitación por noche y los ajustes que se le aplicaron.
portuguese: Quanto custa cada quarto por noite e o que o moveu.

key: What each till took, by payment mode.
english: What each till took, by payment mode.
arabic: ما حصّله كل صندوق حسب طريقة الدفع.
spanish: Lo que cobró cada caja, por forma de pago.
portuguese: O que cada caixa levou, por forma de pagamento.

key: What everyone at this hotel sees until they customise their own Today.
english: What everyone at this hotel sees until they customise their own Today.
arabic: ما يراه الجميع في هذا الفندق حتى يخصّصوا صفحة اليوم الخاصة بهم.
spanish: El diseño que verá el personal del hotel hasta que personalice su propia pantalla Hoy.
portuguese: O que todos neste hotel veem até personalizarem o seu Hoje.

key: What guests pay online when booking on your public page. Existing bookings keep the terms they were made under - a change here only affects new bookings.
english: What guests pay online when booking on your public page. Existing bookings keep the terms they were made under - a change here only affects new bookings.
arabic: ما يدفعه الضيوف عبر الإنترنت عند الحجز من صفحتك العامة. تحتفظ الحجوزات الحالية بشروطها، والتغيير هنا يؤثر على الحجوزات الجديدة فقط.
spanish: Importe que pagan los huéspedes al reservar en su página pública. Las reservas existentes conservan sus condiciones; estos cambios solo se aplican a las nuevas reservas.
portuguese: O que os hóspedes pagam online quando reservam na sua página pública. As reservas existentes mantêm os termos sob os quais foram feitas - uma alteração aqui afeta apenas novas reservas.

key: What happens when a captain sends an order to the kitchen.
english: What happens when a captain sends an order to the kitchen.
arabic: ما يحدث عندما يرسل الكابتن طلبًا إلى المطبخ.

portuguese: O que acontece quando um capitão manda um pedido para a cozinha.

key: What it costs, line by line, with the terms.
english: What it costs, line by line, with the terms.

portuguese: O que é, que seção é preparada e quanto custa fazer uma porção.

key: What physically has to reach the hall, and by when.

portuguese: O que fisicamente deve chegar ao salão e quando.

spanish: Qué incluye el precio por plato
portuguese: O que o preço da placa cobre

key: What they pick is what the kitchen cooks and what the card prints.
english: What they pick is what the kitchen cooks and what the card prints.
arabic: ما يختارونه هو ما يطهوه المطبخ وما يُطبع في القائمة.
spanish: Los platos seleccionados son los que prepara la cocina y aparecen en la carta impresa.
portuguese: O que eles escolhem é o que a cozinha cozinha e o que o cartão imprime.

key: What this money is: against the bill, an advance, or a refundable deposit
english: What this money is: against the bill, an advance, or a refundable deposit
arabic: ما هذا المال: مقابل الفاتورة، أو مقدمة، أو تأمين قابل للاسترداد
spanish: Concepto del pago: abono a la cuenta, anticipo de reserva o depósito de garantía reembolsable
portuguese: O que é esse dinheiro: contra a conta, um adiantamento ou um depósito reembolsável

key: What was actually served. Until this is recorded the bill is a forecast.
english: What was actually served. Until this is recorded the bill is a forecast.
arabic: ما قُدّم فعليًا. حتى يُسجَّل، تبقى الفاتورة تقديرية.
spanish: Lo que se sirvió realmente. Hasta registrarlo, la cuenta es una estimación.
portuguese: O que realmente foi servido. Até que isso seja registrado, a conta é uma previsão.

key: What was done? (kept with the ticket)
english: What was done? (kept with the ticket)
spanish: ¿Qué se hizo? (se guarda en la solicitud)
portuguese: O que foi feito? (mantido com o ingresso)

key: What was quoted, and whether it landed
english: What was quoted, and whether it landed
portuguese: O que foi citado e se chegou

spanish: Importe acordado para los huéspedes adicionales
portuguese: O que você combinou para eles

key: What you sell and the base rate (BAR) for each.
english: What you sell and the base rate (BAR) for each.
arabic: ما تبيعه والسعر الأساسي (BAR) لكل منها.
spanish: Tipos de habitación que ofrece y la tarifa base (BAR) de cada uno.
portuguese: O que você vende e a taxa básica (BAR) de cada um.

key: What's still unsettled while the price is being agreed - and what agreeing it would do to the quote.
english: What's still unsettled while the price is being agreed - and what agreeing it would do to the quote.
arabic: ما لم يُحسم بعد أثناء الاتفاق على السعر، وأثر الاتفاق عليه في عرض السعر.
spanish: Lo que aún está pendiente de acordar y su posible efecto en la cotización.
portuguese: O que ainda não está definido enquanto o preço está sendo acordado - e o que isso afetaria a cotação.

key: WhatsApp and AI chat text is cleared nightly; who, when and delivery status stay. 0 keeps them.
english: WhatsApp and AI chat text is cleared nightly; who, when and delivery status stay. 0 keeps them.
arabic: يُمسح نص محادثات WhatsApp والذكاء الاصطناعي كل ليلة، ويبقى المرسل والوقت وحالة التسليم. 0 يحتفظ بها.
spanish: El texto de WhatsApp y conversaciones de IA se elimina cada noche; se conservan participantes, fechas y estado de entrega. 0 = conservar el texto.
portuguese: O texto do bate-papo do WhatsApp e da IA ​​é apagado todas as noites; quem, quando e status de entrega permanecem. 0 os mantém.

key: WhatsApp the quotation summary to the guest
english: WhatsApp the quotation summary to the guest
arabic: إرسال ملخص عرض السعر إلى الضيف عبر WhatsApp
spanish: Enviar al huésped el resumen de la cotización por WhatsApp
portuguese: Envie por WhatsApp o resumo do orçamento para o hóspede

key: When & how the room is set
english: When & how the room is set
portuguese: Quando e como a quarto está arrumada

key: When a captain sends an order, the kitchen ticket prints immediately and the order shows on the kitchen display as started. Leave this off if the kitchen must press Start.
english: When a captain sends an order, the kitchen ticket prints immediately and the order shows on the kitchen display as started. Leave this off if the kitchen must press Start.
arabic: عند إرسال الطلب تُطبع تذكرة المطبخ فوراً ويظهر الطلب على شاشة المطبخ كأنه بدأ. اتركه مطفأ إذا كان على المطبخ ضغط بدء.
spanish: Cuando el jefe de servicio envía un pedido, la comanda se imprime de inmediato y aparece como iniciada en la pantalla de cocina. Desactive esta opción si el personal de cocina debe pulsar «Iniciar».
portuguese: Quando um capitão envia um pedido, o tíquete da cozinha é impresso imediatamente e o pedido aparece no display da cozinha como iniciado. Deixe esta opção desativada se a cozinha precisar pressionar Iniciar.

key: When a checkout clean is done, a supervisor inspection task is created. Passing it marks the room Ready.
english: When a checkout clean is done, a supervisor inspection task is created. Passing it marks the room Ready.
arabic: عند اكتمال تنظيف المغادرة، تُنشأ مهمة فحص للمشرف. اعتمادها يجعل الغرفة جاهزة.
spanish: Al completar una limpieza por salida se crea una tarea de inspección. Al aprobarla, la habitación queda Lista.
portuguese: Quando a limpeza de check-out é concluída, uma tarefa de inspeção do supervisor é criada. Ao ser aprovada, o quarto é marcado como Pronto.

key: When a credit company has no billing rules
english: When a credit company has no billing rules
arabic: عندما لا تملك شركة الائتمان قواعد فوترة
spanish: Cuando una empresa con crédito no tiene reglas de facturación
portuguese: Quando uma empresa de crédito não tem regras de cobrança

key: When forecast occupancy for a date crosses a threshold, quotes carry the premium automatically and no rate may sell below the hurdle. A room-type tier beats the all-types tier. Guardrails (floor and ceiling) only bound rates set through set_room_rate - Kamra Agent, MCP or the API - not these premiums, staff seasons or quotes.
english: When forecast occupancy for a date crosses a threshold, quotes carry the premium automatically and no rate may sell below the hurdle. A room-type tier beats the all-types tier. Guardrails (floor and ceiling) only bound rates set through set_room_rate - Kamra Agent, MCP or the API - not these premiums, staff seasons or quotes.
arabic: عندما يتجاوز الإشغال المتوقع لتاريخ ما حدًا معينًا، تتضمن عروض الأسعار العلاوة تلقائيًا ولا يُباع أي سعر دون الحد الأدنى. مستوى نوع الغرفة يتقدم على مستوى كل الأنواع. الضوابط (الحد الأدنى والأعلى) تقيّد فقط الأسعار المحددة عبر set_room_rate (Kamra Agent أو MCP أو API)، وليس هذه العلاوات أو مواسم الموظفين أو عروض الأسعار.
spanish: Cuando la ocupación prevista supera un umbral, se aplica un recargo automático a las cotizaciones y una tarifa mínima de venta. El nivel específico de un tipo de habitación tiene prioridad sobre el general. Los límites mínimo y máximo solo se aplican a tarifas establecidas mediante set_room_rate (Kamra Agent, MCP o API), no a estos recargos, temporadas del personal ni cotizaciones.
portuguese: Quando a ocupação prevista para uma data ultrapassa um limite, as cotações carregam o prêmio automaticamente e nenhuma tarifa pode ser vendida abaixo da barreira. Uma camada de tipo de quarto supera a camada de todos os tipos. As proteções (piso e teto) vinculam apenas as taxas definidas por meio de set_room_rate - Agente Kamra, MCP ou API - e não esses prêmios, temporadas de funcionários ou cotações.

key: When it is served - kitchen holds later courses until the table is ready
english: When it is served - kitchen holds later courses until the table is ready
arabic: موعد التقديم: يؤجل المطبخ الأطباق اللاحقة حتى تجهز الطاولة
spanish: Momento de servicio: la cocina retiene los tiempos posteriores hasta que la mesa esté lista
portuguese: Quando é servido - a cozinha mantém os pratos posteriores até a mesa estar pronta

key: When off, phone and ID numbers in tool results are shortened to the last four digits before they leave Kamra.
english: When off, phone and ID numbers in tool results are shortened to the last four digits before they leave Kamra.
arabic: عند الإيقاف، تُختصر أرقام الهاتف والهوية في نتائج الأدوات إلى آخر أربعة أرقام قبل خروجها من Kamra.
spanish: Cuando está desactivado, los números de teléfono y de identificación en los resultados de la herramienta se reducen a los últimos cuatro dígitos antes de salir de Kamra.
portuguese: Quando desativado, os números de telefone e de identificação nos resultados da ferramenta são reduzidos para os últimos quatro dígitos antes de saírem do Kamra.

key: When the guest pays, the deposit posts here automatically.
english: When the guest pays, the deposit posts here automatically.
arabic: عند دفع النزيل، يُسجَّل العربون هنا تلقائيًا.
spanish: Cuando el huésped pague, el anticipo se registrará aquí automáticamente.
portuguese: Quando o hóspede paga, o depósito é lançado aqui automaticamente.

key: When the night audit turns an arrival that never came into a No Show, and who pays for it. The fee itself is the no-show charge under Stay policies.
english: When the night audit turns an arrival that never came into a No Show, and who pays for it. The fee itself is the no-show charge under Stay policies.
arabic: متى يحوّل التدقيق الليلي الوصول الذي لم يحدث إلى عدم حضور، ومن يدفع. الرسوم نفسها هي رسوم عدم الحضور في سياسات الإقامة.
spanish: Cuándo la auditoría marca como no presentada una llegada que no ocurrió y quién paga. El cargo se configura en Políticas de estancia.
portuguese: Quando a auditoria noturna transforma uma chegada que nunca chegou em No Show, e quem paga por isso. A taxa em si é a cobrança de não comparecimento de acordo com as políticas de estadia.

arabic: وجهة التذكرة إذا تعطلت هذه الطابعة.
spanish: Impresora a la que se enviará la comanda si esta falla.
portuguese: Para onde vai um tíquete se esta impressora falhar.

key: Which bookings show against a table on the POS floor.
english: Which bookings show against a table on the POS floor.
arabic: الحجوزات التي تظهر على الطاولة في مخطط POS.
spanish: Reservas que aparecen asociadas a una mesa en el punto de venta.
portuguese: Quais reservas são exibidas em uma mesa no PDV.

key: Which hall - free for these dates and hours
english: Which hall - free for these dates and hours
arabic: أي قاعة - متاحة لهذه التواريخ والساعات
spanish: Salones disponibles para estas fechas y horarios
portuguese: Qual salão - gratuito nessas datas e horários
